spec_match.rationale: Runs the real decidable preflight — Intl canonicalisation, locale-data availability, user-language overlap, credential presence — before any dialog, and stages the checkout fallback ladder for the parts only show() can decide, which is the correct reading of the locale-validation change.

interactive.rationale: A trusted click ran the full preflight with per-step verdicts, chose the honest fallback (card form, for want of a credential), and Reset restores the flow; amount/subtotal fields feed the request.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card frames refusal-survival as checkout design and the page delivers a working degradation ladder.

edge_cases.rationale: No-credential, bad-locale, and no-data preconditions each fail individually with distinct copy, and the not-a-locale-failure distinction is called out.

conformance.rationale: The suite is deliberately executable pre-154 (construction, JSON serialisation, canMakePayment, Intl matching) and ran 7 pass / 0 fail on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): trusted CDP click ran the preflight — three locale steps ok against the browser's en-US, credential step honestly failed, checkout fell to the card form with the correct explanation; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs preflight failures and the chosen method.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, numbered step list, method panels, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Steps are an ordered list with text verdicts, detail is aria-live, form fields are labelled, buttons are 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/secure-payment-confirmation-locale-validation/checkout-that-degrades/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The preflight ran for real: locale tags canonicalised and matched against the browser's actual en-US preference, the missing credential was caught before any sheet could open, and the checkout degraded to the card form with copy explaining that this is not a locale failure. This is exactly the decidable-before-show() discipline the feature rewards. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 7 pass / 0 fail on this build. Clears the bar.
